$comment: What the agent is, independent of any platform. The system prompt is prompt.md. `runtime` names the folder in providers/ that runs it.
name: Vedanth Web Agent
firstMessage: Hey, I'm Vedanth. Not actually, I'm the AI version, but you get the idea. Product manager, working in voice AI. How can I help?

actions.name: show_section
actions.description: Scroll the caller's page to the section you are talking about. Call it in the same turn as your answer, never instead of one.

section.description: work = roles and products. about = the story, school, college. interests = chess, snooker, climbing. contact = booking a call or email.

caller_name.description: The caller's first name if they gave one, otherwise empty.

caller_org_role.description: The caller's organisation and role if offered, otherwise empty.

caller_intent.description: Why they called. Recruiting is expected and fine.

outcome.description: How the call was routed at the close.

unanswered.description: Anything the agent could not answer. This is the backlog for improving the knowledge base.
